title: GPT 5.6 replaced my entire outbound team
description:
Cold email always forced a tradeoff.

Personal, or scalable.

Never both.

Finding the leads was one job.

Writing the emails was another.

Making them feel personal was a third.

Three people. Three bottlenecks.

Now it's one prompt.

You describe the client you want.

Clay finds them, enriches them, and drafts the email.

Then it writes a fresh first line for every single person.

Not a template with a name swapped in.

A real opener, written for each one.

That's the part nobody's ready for.

The tell that screamed "mass email" just disappeared.

Like a printing press that hand-writes every copy.

The team was never the magic.

The manual work was the ceiling.

Remove it, and one person outbounds like fifty.

#clay #codex #gpt5 #coldemail #outbound
